	capie_v1_ed__rn__legacy = {
		context_type = player_context
		window_name = "capie_v1_ed__rn__legacy"
		visible = { has_country_flag = rn_input NOT = { has_country_flag = rn_lg_keyboard } }
		ai_enabled = { always = no }
		effects = {
			capie_v1_ed__rn__legacy_apply_click = { rn_lg_field_apply = yes rn_gui_touch = yes }
			rn_lg_cancel_click = { rn_cancel_input = yes }
			rn_lg_use_keyboard_click = { set_country_flag = rn_lg_keyboard rn_cv1_status_clear = yes rn_gui_touch = yes }
		}
		triggers = {
			capie_v1_ep__rn__legacy_visible = { always = no }
			rn_lg_target_prov_visible = { check_variable = { rn_ttype = 3 } }
			rn_lg_target_country_visible = { check_variable = { rn_ttype > 3 } }
		}
		dynamic_lists = {
			rn_lg_target_grid = {
				array = rn_display_target
				value = rn_header_target
				change_scope = no
				entry_container = "rn_target_entry"
			}
		}
	}

	rn_state_view_gui = {
		context_type = selected_state_context
		parent_window_token = selected_state_view
		window_name = "rn_state_view_window"
		visible = { is_owned_by = ROOT }
		ai_enabled = { always = no }
		effects = {
			rn_sv_rename_click = {
				if = {
					limit = { is_owned_by = ROOT NOT = { rn_feature_states_off = yes } }
					ROOT = { rn_target_state = yes }
				}
			}
			rn_sv_cities_click = {
				if = {
					limit = { is_owned_by = ROOT NOT = { rn_feature_states_off = yes } }
					ROOT = {
						set_country_flag = rn_open
						clr_country_flag = rn_input
						set_variable = { rn_sel_state = PREV }
						set_temp_variable = { rn_newtab = 4 }
						rn_set_tab = yes
					}
				}
			}
			rn_sv_reset_click = {
				if = {
					limit = { is_owned_by = ROOT NOT = { rn_feature_states_off = yes } }
					reset_state_name = yes
					ROOT = { rn_gui_touch = yes }
				}
			}
		}
		triggers = {
			rn_sv_rename_click_enabled = { ROOT = { NOT = { rn_cd_state_active = yes } } NOT = { rn_feature_states_off = yes } }
			rn_sv_cities_click_enabled = { NOT = { rn_feature_states_off = yes } }
			rn_sv_reset_click_enabled = { NOT = { rn_feature_states_off = yes } }
		}
	}
}
